question.text: Upon entering a Dissolution Period, a Cat III AIF scheme:

answer.text: Can accept fresh commitments but no new investments
Shall NOT accept fresh commitments and shall NOT make new investments

explanation.text: **The Logic:** Per Section 5.17 (Dissolution Period), the scheme shall not accept fresh commitments from investors and shall not make any new investments. **The Trap:** Fresh commitments and new investments are strictly prohibited; structure conversion is not available. **Cross-Exam Context:** Introduced via SEBI (AIF) Second Amendment Regulations, 2024. **Distributor's Pro-Tip:** Run investor communication in parallel with dissolution-period consent to manage expectations on timelines.
